server.//publicBaseUrl: Public origin (scheme+host[:port], no trailing slash) prepended to browser-loadable wiki-image URLs. Leave empty for root-relative URLs when the client shares the server's origin. Env: MOSS_PUBLIC_BASE_URL.

//runtimeDefaults.type: THE runtime switch: 'docker' | 'k8s' | 'host'. Set to 'k8s' to run every session as a gvisor pod (see the k8s block below). Env override: MOSS_DEFAULT_RUNTIME.
//k8s: gvisor pod runtime. Only consulted when runtimeDefaults.type='k8s'. Every field below is env-overridable (see per-field notes); the file values persist so a plain restart keeps k8s mode.

k8s.//image: scode pod image (scode is baked in — nothing staged on the node). 'moss-runtime:latest' is a stable alias install-k3s.sh tags onto whatever version it imported, so this never needs re-pinning per release. Env: MOSS_SCODE_IMAGE.
k8s.//namespace: Session pods live here. Matches install-k3s.sh. Env: MOSS_K8S_NAMESPACE.
k8s.//runtimeClassName: gvisor RuntimeClass installed by install-k3s.sh. Set to "" (empty) to omit it on a customer cluster that has no gvisor RuntimeClass — pods then use the cluster's default runtime. Env: MOSS_K8S_RUNTIME_CLASS.
k8s.//kubeconfig: kubeconfig install-k3s.sh generates, written beside this server.json. For an existing customer cluster, point this at their kubeconfig instead. Env: MOSS_K8S_KUBECONFIG.
k8s.//imagePullPolicy: Pod imagePullPolicy. 'IfNotPresent' suits a node-imported image (k3s flow) AND a customer-registry image (pulled when absent). Use 'Always' to always pull. Env: MOSS_K8S_IMAGE_PULL_POLICY.
k8s.//imagePullSecrets: Names of pre-created dockerconfigjson Secrets for pulling the runtime image from a private registry (customer clusters). Empty = none. Env: MOSS_K8S_IMAGE_PULL_SECRETS (comma-separated).
